{{Item Info|title1=Tunnel|image1=Tunnel.png|type=Block|id=srparasites:tunnel}}
'''Tunnels''' (also known as Buglin Tunnels) are a unique type of [[Blocks|Block]]. 

== ''Description'' ==
Between [[Evolution Phases#Phase -1|Phase -1]] and [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]], if a [[Rupter]] gets 5 or more kills, it can place down a Tunnel block, and its killcount value will be reduced by 5. [[Buglin|Buglins]] will regularly spawn from Tunnel blocks, as if they are emerging from deep underground. A [[Buglin]] also spawns when the Tunnel block is broken.
